pages.text: “Crimson blooms, a subtle fragrance, nurtured by flowing waters, a sacred herb of the riverside.”$(br2)Verbena is a herbaceous plant that thrives in moist environments. Its tiny crimson flowers not only have ornamental value but are also widely used in herbal medicine and tea-making. With its refreshing aroma and mild medicinal properties, it is known as the ‘Flower of the Riverbank.’

Wild verbena is commonly found along riverbanks and in humid grasslands, flourishing near water sources. Travelers can search these areas for wild verbena and collect its seeds to cultivate a stable supply of tea ingredients.

When mature, verbena plants yield delicate crimson flowers and additional seeds for continued cultivation.$(br)The flowers carry a light and pleasant fragrance, making them ideal for brewing refreshing herbal teas or blending into medicinal preparations.
